name: backup-also-dead
description: SIMULATED SETTING, not a measurement: link delays are configured so that A-B and B-C (10 ms one way) are cheaper than A-D and D-C (25 ms one way). B and D both stop at 12 s. A's backup is dead too, so A enters no_route locally, drops new readings with reason no_route, and originates a failover report with no target. A is cut off, so the report cannot leave it; it is repeated a bounded number of times and nothing grows.
